author: snupilab
description:
ToolBook: HumanoidToolBench demonstrations
	

Paper: arXiv:2610.02089
Raw Meta Quest teleoperation demonstrations for
HumanoidToolBench, recorded on
the Unitree G1 in MuJoCo through its whole-body controller.
Each recording uses LeRobot v2.1 files: 50 Hz, an ego-view video and wrist-view
videos when recorded, and the recording contract in meta/simple_contract.json.
Camera resolutions are
declared in meta/info.json. Code versions, WBC settings, and the render
backend are in… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/snupilab/humanoidtoolbench-teleop.
